content: {"episode_id":"ep-05084","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73). The study was indicated to evaluate for arrhythmic causes of these transient cerebral ischemic events (G45.9) and to guide anticoagulation management. The monitoring service is therefore a distinct, medically necessary diagnostic evaluation supported by the documented clinical indication, and we request reconsideration of the CO-97 denial."}
